response.title: Watching the Stream
response.passage: A science class visited a stream to learn how water moves. They noticed that a strong current carried fallen leaves past a row of rocks. The students placed small markers beside the bank and watched how quickly the leaves passed them. Their teacher asked them to compare these observations with the current measurements from the previous visit. Those earlier records showed that the water had moved more slowly after several dry days. Since the leaves now passed the markers faster, the class concluded that the stream was moving more quickly than before.
